description.narrative: Overall Objective: Improved community-based conflict resolution through increased women's participation and strengthened livelihoods. Outcome 1: Improved capacity of community based institutions to reduce and/or transform conflict and increase inter- and intr-group trust. Outcome 2: Enhanced management and equality of access to resources, assets and services, particularly for women. Outcome 3: Improved and diversified livelihood opportunities for vulnerable groups, especially women.

The primary beneficiaries are women, women-headed households, and very poor households. AKF will also work with an assortment of CBIs such as Community Development Councils (CDCs), Water User Associations (WUAs), Community Based Natural Resource Management (CBNRM) groups, District Steering Committees (DSCs), Common Interest Groups (CIGs) and Community Based Saving Groups (CBSGs) and capacitate them to sensitize the community regarding conflict, its causes and effects, as well as directly address conflict at the community level with an eye for its peaceful resolution.

The proposed project will target key drivers of conflict in 40 remote districts of 8 provinces (Badakhshan, Takhar, Kunduz, Baghlan, Samangan, Bamyan, Parwan and Daykundi) through a combination of interlinked interventions which create an enabling environment for local peacebuilding by building the capacity of local institutions to engage in conflict resolution, facilitating solutions to natural resource-based tensions, and reducing poverty (particularly the feminization of poverty), inequalities and exclusions by supporting women’s meaningful participation in the economy and decision-making. The districts have been selected based on their vulnerability to disasters (man-made and natural), limited natural endowments, direct dependence of the population on natural resources, geographical remoteness, and the potential for women economic engagement. The primary beneficiaries are women, women-headed households, and very poor households. Overall, the project will reach 20,000 households (140,000 individuals, 50% women) with improved community-based conflict resolution through enhanced women’s participation and strengthened livelihoods.

tag.narrative: Outcome 2 will contribute to SDG 15 as it focuses on creating Natural Resource Management plans within communities and providing funding and support to implement NRM projects that improve sustainability.
Outcome 3 will contribute to SDG 2 by providing training and in-kind support to producers as well as transfer of productive assets to women, such as the needed tools/equipment for kitchen gardens.

Outcomes 2 and 3 of the project directly contribute to SDG 1, particularly for women. Outcome 1 will increase women's access to and control over natural resources and assets, enabling increased income-generating opportunities. Outcome 2 will provide training and support to women, both as individuals (vocational training, livelihood investment planning) and as part of micro and small enterprises. It will also improve access to finance for women.

The entire project aims to contribute to SDG 16 through peacebuilding efforts, including increasing women's participation in peacebuidling, strengthening existing community-based peacebuidling mechanisms and introducing new ones, and creating platforms for conflict resolution around natural resources.
The entire project aims to contribute to SDG 5 through women's economic empowerment as well as increasing women's voices in peacebuilding and the management of natural resources.

policy-marker.narrative: Outcome 2 of the project aims to enhance management of natural resources
The project aims to improve gender equality through strengthening women's economic empowerment and improving women's participation in peacebuidling.

The project aims to strengthen participatory development and good governance by strengthening community-based platforms and mechanisms for peacebuilding and governance, with a primary emphasis on increasing women's participation in these mechanisms.
